Why do businesses partner with BBSI?

Businesses partner with BBSI to reduce administrative burden, manage workforce risk, offer competitive benefits, and gain expert guidance that helps them operate more efficiently and grow with confidence.
How does BBSI’s PEO model work?
BBSI partners with your business to manage payroll, HR, benefits, compliance guidance, and risk management, while you maintain full control over your employees and day‑to‑day operations.
What services does BBSI provide?

BBSI offers payroll administration, HR consulting, workers’ compensation and risk management, health benefits and retirement plans, staffing and recruiting, and a unified HRIS platform to manage everything in one place.
How is BBSI different from other PEOs?
BBSI pairs nationwide resources with local, dedicated specialists, providing hands‑on support from professionals who understand your business, industry, and regional regulations.
Does BBSI work with small businesses or large companies?
BBSI supports businesses of every size and stage, from growing small businesses to larger, multi‑location organizations across a wide range of industries.
Does BBSI offer staffing and recruiting services?
Yes. BBSI provides end‑to‑end staffing and talent solutions, including direct placement, contract‑to‑hire, temporary and seasonal staffing, plus screening, onboarding, and retention support.
What industries does BBSI serve?
BBSI supports businesses across many industries, including construction, manufacturing, healthcare, hospitality, transportation, professional services, franchises, and more.
How does BBSI help with workers’ compensation and risk management?
BBSI delivers workers’ compensation coverage, pay‑as‑you‑go premiums, claims management, safety training, and loss control strategies designed to reduce risk and control costs.
Can BBSI help my business offer better employee benefits?
Yes. Through the PEO model, BBSI helps businesses access competitive medical, dental, vision, and retirement plans, along with full benefits administration and compliance support.
How do I get started with BBSI?
You can connect with a local BBSI expert using the form below to discuss your business needs, explore pricing, and build a customized workforce solution that fits your goals.

Built on Trust & Backed by Expertise
Learn what makes BBSI a trusted partner for businesses nationwide.
Founded in 1951, BBSI has grown from a staffing company into a nationwide PEO providing payroll, HR, risk, and strategic workforce support.
Local Teams for Every Client

BBSI sets the standard for trust and compliance in the PEO industry. ESAC-accredited with SOC 1 certification, BBSI meets rigorous financial, ethical, and operational standards to protect clients and their employees.
The Leaders That Guide Our Mission
Our leadership team steers BBSI with disciplined strategy, industry expertise, and a commitment to delivering consistent results for the businesses we serve.

Gary Kramer joined BBSI in 2016 and became Chief Executive Officer in 2020 after serving as CFO. He brings more than 15 years of insurance industry experience and leads BBSI’s strategic growth and risk focus.
Drexel MBA, Rowan BSBA | Strategy & Risk

Gerald Blotz joined BBSI in 2002 and now serves as Chief Operating Officer, overseeing field operations nationwide. He brings decades of operational leadership experience scaling multi‑location organizations.
Anthony Harris joined BBSI in 2016 and was appointed Chief Financial Officer in 2020. He leads the company’s financial strategy, reporting, and long‑term fiscal planning.
WSU BSBA, CPA | Finance
James Potts brings more than 25 years of legal experience to his role as General Counsel at BBSI. He oversees legal, regulatory, and governance matters with a strong focus on compliance and risk.
Georgetown JD, UF BSBA | Legal
BBSI’s Board of Directors provide the strategic oversight and leadership that anchor our mission.
BBSI governance materials and financial information can be found on our Investor Relations site.

How long has BBSI been in business?
Barret Business Services was founded in 1951 and has more than 75 years of experience supporting businesses with workforce management, risk mitigation, and operational guidance.
What makes BBSI different from other PEOs?

BBSI differentiates itself through dedicated local support teams, industry‑specific expertise, a strong focus on risk management, and a people‑first service model backed by integrated HR and payroll technology.
What types of businesses does BBSI work with?

BBSI works with businesses of all sizes and structures, including small to midsize businesses, large and multi‑location companies, franchise systems, and professional partners such as brokers and CPAs.
Does BBSI support both white‑collar and labor‑intensive industries?

Yes, BBSI supports a wide range of industries, from white‑collar and professional services to high‑risk, labor‑intensive environments, tailoring workforce solutions to each business’s operational needs.
What services does BBSI provide?

BBSI provides comprehensive PEO services including payroll and HR, risk management, workers’ compensation, compliance support, employee benefits, staffing, strategic planning, and workforce technology.
How does BBSI support businesses across multiple locations?

BBSI delivers consistent workforce solutions through standardized processes, centralized technology, and local expertise, helping businesses maintain compliance and operational alignment across locations and states.
How does BBSI support brokers, CPAs, and franchise networks?

BBSI partners with brokers, CPAs, and franchise organizations to provide scalable workforce solutions that support multiple clients or locations while preserving trusted relationships and operational consistency.
myBBSI is BBSI’s integrated HRIS platform that centralizes payroll, HR administration, document management, recruiting, onboarding, and timekeeping in one secure, accessible system.
Is BBSI accredited and compliant with industry standards?
Yes, BBSI is ESAC‑accredited, SOC 1 certified, a NAPEO member, and governed by an independent board of directors, meeting rigorous financial, ethical, and operational standards.
Why do businesses choose BBSI as their PEO partner?
Businesses choose BBSI for its combination of local expertise, national scale, strong compliance and risk focus, integrated technology, and long‑term partnership approach.

Entrepreneurs nationwide rely on BBSI for hands-on support that helps them overcome challenges, build stronger operations, and grow with confidence.

My name is Adam Sedlak. I'm the CEO of UFC Gym. That means I oversee everything from sales operations, fitness, real estate, accounting, finance, but, of course, payroll, HR, and recruiting. The industry is in a very unique position, but it's the complication of competition, the complication of minimum wage increases, the bureaucracy of how we deal with all the labor laws, and all the other variables that we constantly have to react to, is definitely something that is dealt with on a daily, if not hourly basis. Before partnering with BBSI, I would say we had a lot of complications. We lacked transparency with our vendor at the time. And, really, I didn't feel the appropriate contribution to help us drive and move the business forward. It was almost like I reported to them as a vendor. So UFC Gym is a complicated company in a complicated industry. Quite frankly, initially, I didn't know if they were the right vendor. It was a referral from a very close friend of mine. But as I lifted the lid and I looked underneath the hood of the car, I found all the value proposition points that BBSI offered. They created a very simplistic platform to allow me to focus on what my job really is, versus having to be an expert in HR, an expert in payroll, and an expert in recruiting. The support of BBSI has been tremendous. So instead of spending half my day trying to confirm that people got paid correctly, or if I had an HR issue, or how to staff a facility, I now have a tremendous, not just vendor, but a partner that helps me get better in all those avenues. So I would say they've increased my efficiency so I can focus on what's most important in our business, and quite frankly, it allows me to be a better leader as a CEO of a big organization. In the fitness industry, it can be very complicated because we have a lot of variable pay. We have fixed pay. We have bonus pay, and we have people that work at multiple facilities. BBSI was able to take all the complication of our payroll compensation plans and simplify it so the output became easy to execute off of. So, yeah, I would say they've created simplicity for me so we can make sure we pay people correctly, but more importantly, the transparency is in place. State laws are changing all the time, and literally, you have to have a doctorate to understand what each state does and how they react on an annual basis. So by having BBSI in place, I don't have to worry about any of that. It's all provided for us. Not only that, they're such great partners. They're proactive in their communication versus being reactive. Many vendors, what I found over my years of experience in the industry, you have to chase them down. That's not the case with BBSI. They come to us, give us the information, and allow us to react with plenty of notice. We have a lot of priorities as an organization. I mean, certainly, automation with AI and how we deliver to our consumers is critically important to us. We have a very strong value proposition. Now, if you're gonna have a strong value proposition, you better have a pretty strong team. And so not only is BBSI going to help me with the recruiting strategy of getting top-notch talent into the UFC Gym family, but importantly, it's how we hold team members accountable, how we train them, how we make sure that we comply with all the local and state laws that have to be dealt with in the complication of how you retain employees. So I would say BBSI has been incredibly resourceful in helping me build the business and focus the right people on the right things.
